rationale: The stock is trading near the bottom of its range (11% position) with a significant gap down, but the 1-minute candles show accelerating volume on the downside (322k shares in the last minute) and price is below the 9-EMA, indicating strong short-term momentum that makes a long entry a "catching a falling knife" scenario.
